rss: Speed camera fault may have allowed drivers to escape fines
title: Toy Cars Zoom Without Speed Limits!
story: There was a mix-up with the toy car speed cameras, so toy car drivers didn't get any slow-down warnings. They zoomed around without any tickets!
storyBig: A fault in the RC car speed monitoring system allowed drivers to race without penalties. This oversight could affect how companies manage toy safety regulations.
think: Why is it important to follow speed limits, even with toy cars?
bull: You can imagine driving fast and free!
bear: Not having speed checks can make playtime unsafe.

rss: Where are the most jobs for 18-24 year-olds?
title: Finding the Perfect Job in Toyland
story: Toyland is full of exciting jobs! From building bricks to designing new plush toys, there's something for everyone to do. Where would you like to work?
storyBig: The toy industry is expanding its workforce, seeking young talent to innovate in areas like brick construction and plush toy design. This could be a prime opportunity for new careers in creative fields.
think: What job would you enjoy doing in Toyland?
bull: Lots of new jobs mean more fun toys!
bear: Choosing the right job can be tricky.
